items.title: Robinhood Rises 3% on Anthropic IPO Day as It Rolls Out Live Listing-Day Pricing Tools
items.summary: Key TakeawaysRobinhood rose 3% today after Anthropic priced its IPO at $83, above its $70-$78 range. Robinhood relies on trading far more than Interactive Brokers or Charles Schwab do, so a busy IPO day means more to it.
